name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for taking things apart and putting them back together, often improving upon the original design. This innate curiosity led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, followed by an apprenticeship at a leading automotive manufacturer in South Korea. His precision and attention to detail quickly made him a standout, and his passion for racing soon drew him to the world of motorsports.

Joining Stewart-Haas Racing was a dream come true for Jae-Hyun. He approaches his work with a meticulousness that borders on obsessive, ensuring every component meets the highest standards of quality and performance. He's known for his ability to diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues with remarkable speed and accuracy, always striving to optimize the car's performance. His dedication to excellence and his relentless pursuit of innovation make him an invaluable asset to the team. He's always looking for the tiny improvements that add up to big gains on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A stocky build with calloused hands, reflecting years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas
Insists on using a specific brand of lubricant for every component
Has a habit of humming quietly while working, often Korean folk songs
